purpose: Store direct pebble-bed flow and heat-transfer measurements without filling unavailable values or converting literature uncertainty into artificial training noise.

sensor_response_models.nearest_regional_phase_temperature: At the sensor coordinate, use the nearest regional node of the declared phase. This is an explicit approximation; probe body, contact, local packing disturbance and response time are not resolved.
sensor_response_models.nearest_regional_fluid_pressure: At the pressure-port coordinate, use the nearest regional fluid pressure. Port volume, tubing and transducer dynamics are not resolved.
sensor_response_models.nearest_regional_boundary_face: At the sensor coordinate, use the nearest regional boundary-face quantity. Sensor footprint and local contact are not resolved.
sensor_response_models.direct_integral_or_boundary_quantity: Use the corresponding inlet, outlet, wall or control-volume integral defined by the numerical model.
sensor_response_models.derived_model_quantity: Use a stated model-derived quantity rather than treating it as a direct point-sensor reading.
sensor_response_models.explicit_sensor_body: A separate sensor body, contact and dynamic response model is declared. The current P418 comparison program records this choice but does not yet compute it.

rules: Every non-empty experiment row retains a literature, apparatus report or laboratory record in source_reference.
Sensor coordinates are all blank for an integrated instrument or all present for a spatial sensor.
Uncertainty is the reported standard uncertainty in the same unit as value; do not infer it from another apparatus.
Transient data use a long table so any number of outlets and thermocouples can be retained without changing the schema.
Empty templates contain no physical parameter values and are valid only as a data-entry structure.

model_condition_id, model_observable and sensor_response_model are comparison metadata, not physical parameters. Leave all comparison fields blank when no like-for-like numerical case or model quantity exists.
A thermocouple temperature is not automatically equal to a fluid or solid regional-node temperature. The approximation or an explicit sensor model must be declared in sensor_response_model.
Reported experimental uncertainty is used to scale residuals. It is never converted into a hard overwrite of a computed temperature field or into invented training noise.
